name: Official ByteTrack association on identical unscored native DLM proposals
input_score_policy: All original unscored proposals enter with explicit constant1, no learned/fabricated detector-confidence claim; low-score branch has no inputs.
output_policy: All active tracks returned by unmodified upstream tracker API; no additional area/aspect/score postfilter.
output_boxes: native ByteTrack Kalman-filtered estimates; not forced equal to detection boxes
lost_buffer: Official frame_rate/30*track_buffer convention,1s with these defaults; differs from GroundJEV3s.
scope: One complete legal validation0004 video; association-only same-candidate control, not the full YOLOX+ByteTrack pipeline, published score reproduction or ordinary-model parity proof.
